full_prompt_en: A square painterly realistic image shows a young red-haired woman in close left-facing profile among softly blurred foliage. Her head and shoulders occupy the center and right side, while the left side holds sunlit leaves and bright out-of-focus circles. Long copper hair falls in loose waves down her back and chest; stray strands glow where they cross the light beside her cheek. Her eyes look downward, and the nose, lips, and chin form a quiet, finely observed silhouette against the lighter background. The expression is thoughtful and relaxed, with no direct contact with the viewer. A warm ocher garment with a small repeating motif covers her shoulder and upper arm at the lower right. The remaining clothing is mostly outside the close crop, so the face and hair carry the image. Above her head, patches of green leaf and pale sky break into creamy bokeh, and the right background descends into deeper brown-green shadow. The skin is softly modeled, retaining small natural color variations rather than a flat painted plane. Hair strands are individually legible near the rim light, then merge into thicker dark waves farther from the sun. The viewpoint is at face height and close enough to make the profile the central shape, while the garden surroundings remain suggestive rather than sharply mapped. Warm late-day light comes from behind and to the upper left, outlining hair and forehead, touching the cheek and garment, and letting the far side of the face fall into gentle shade. No text or additional figure appears. The overall composition is intimate and luminous, balancing amber hair and skin against mottled green shadow and soft circular highlights.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形绘画感的写实图像呈现一位年轻红发女子在柔化树叶间朝左的近距离侧面。她的头肩占据中央与右侧，左边是受阳光照亮的叶片和失焦亮圆。长长的铜红头发以松散波浪垂到背部和胸前；零散发丝经过脸颊旁的光时发亮。她的目光向下，鼻、唇与下巴在较亮背景前形成安静而细致的轮廓。神情沉思放松，并未直视观看者。下右方一件带小重复花纹的暖赭色衣衫覆盖肩与上臂。其余衣服多在紧密裁切之外，因此面孔与头发承担画面。头顶上方，绿色叶片与浅天光碎成奶油色散景，右侧背景渐入较深棕绿阴影。皮肤得到柔和塑形，仍保留细微自然色差，而非平坦色面。发丝在边缘光附近一根根可辨，离开阳光后则融成更厚的深色波浪。视点与面部齐高且足够贴近，使侧面成为中央形状，花园环境则保持暗示性而非清楚地图。暖暮光从后方偏左上照来，勾亮头发和额头，触及脸颊与衣料，让脸的远侧落入温柔暗影。没有文字或其他人物。整体构图亲密而发亮，以琥珀色头发与皮肤平衡斑驳绿影和柔软圆形亮点。
style_prompt_en: The image has a painterly photoreal surface with close natural modeling and a shallow, softly mottled background. Warm amber and copper tones stand against muted olive, moss, and deep brown-green, while creamy light spots punctuate the darker field. Fine filament-like edges glow at the light boundary, but larger contours stay gentle and almost dissolve into shadow. Surface texture is subtle: small tonal variations and soft grain preserve natural material without visible heavy brush ridges. Backlight from one upper side creates a luminous rim and warm translucent highlights; the opposite planes retain quiet, rounded shade. A tight crop concentrates the focal form and lets surrounding detail blur into overlapping circles and leaf-like marks. The overall effect is romantic, calm, and tactile, with light and color depth carrying the visual identity.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有绘画般的照片写实表面，近处自然塑形与浅景深、柔和斑驳的背景相结合。暖琥珀与铜色对照低调橄榄绿、苔绿和深棕绿，奶油色光点点缀较暗色域。细丝般边缘在光的交界处发亮，大轮廓却温柔，几乎融入阴影。表面纹理细微：小幅明度变化与柔和颗粒保留自然材料感，没有可见的厚重笔棱。从一侧上方来的逆光形成发亮轮廓与温暖透光亮部；相反的平面保有安静圆润的阴影。紧密裁切集中焦点形体，让周围细节模糊为重叠圆点和叶片般笔迹。整体效果浪漫、安静且可触，由光线与色彩深度承载视觉身份。
theme_en: A red-haired young woman in profile amid sunlit foliage
theme_zh: 阳光树叶间一位红发年轻女子的侧面特写
name: Yigal Ozeri
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
